divider_source: Natural Earth 1:50m Geographic Regions Polygons 5.0.0, Europe physical-region eastern boundary; extended through water
definition_notes: Africa includes Madagascar and source African-region islands plus Mayotte/Reunion; whole Egypt including Sinai retained.
North America includes Greenland, Central America, Caribbean and Arctic islands; Hawaii excluded.
South America includes French Guiana, Falklands and source regional islands.
Australia means mainland, Tasmania and represented nearshore islands within 110–155 E, 45–9 S; not all Oceania or New Guinea.

Europe/Asia divide transcontinental countries using the saved source-derived mask. Source-country island allocation is retained elsewhere; Cyprus is Asia. This is a disclosed geographic/cartographic convention, not a sovereignty position.
Antarctica combines the source country polygon with Natural Earth 1:50m perennial ice shelves v4.1.0 (2003–04 mosaic lineage). No seasonal sea ice; not a current ice-front survey.

Area is coastline-enclosed polygon surface after uniformly filling interior rings for all continents. It includes enclosed inland water, not a dry-land mask. Original source holes are retained separately.
search_proxy_policy: Simplify at 18 km without topology retention, then repair proxy only; delivered full geometry is not simplified or clipped.
area_definition: WGS84 ellipsoidal surface area of assembled continent polygons after uniformly filling interior rings. Coastline-enclosed surface, including enclosed inland water; not dry-land area. Water touching the continent divider or coast remains outside. Original source holes retained separately.
